ICS 71.060CHD 01New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard (Part 1) covers the requirements and method of test for non-metallurgical grade (chemical grade) calcined alumina.2. REFERENCESThe Indian Standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards:264 : 2005 Nitric aid - Specification (third revision)266 : 1993 Sulphuric acid - Specification (third revision)1070 : 1992 Reagent grade water (third revision)4200 : 2020 Sodium aluminate - Specification (second revision)
